beats.title: Dock with Agena
beats.text: First job: dock with Agena, the target vehicle ahead of you. Send Cal the order below and he'll fly the approach.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is flying the docking approach (a few seconds).

beats.title: Docked
beats.text: Docked and steady. Time runs faster while nothing needs you, and the console slows it down the moment something does.

rail.do: Wait — time runs fast until the console needs you.

beats.title: Acknowledge the alarm
beats.text: Something is firing on its own and the stack has started to roll. Press ACK once the alarm sounds, or Got it to go straight after the culprit.

rail.do: Press ACK when the alarm sounds, or Got it to go straight on.

beats.title: Find the stuck thruster
beats.text: A thruster that won't stop firing runs hot. Ask June to read the thruster temperatures and the culprit will give itself away.

rail.wait: Wait — June is reading the thruster temperatures (a few seconds).

beats.title: Cut power to T8
beats.text: Thruster 8 is the hot one: its driver has shorted and it keeps firing. Have June open its breaker to stop it.

rail.wait: Wait — June is opening the T8 breaker (a few seconds).

beats.title: Stop the roll
beats.text: T8 is quiet, but the stack is still rolling. Have Cal rate damp on the OAMS thrusters to bring it to rest.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is damping the roll.

beats.title: Raise the orbit
beats.text: The roll has stopped. Fire Agena's engine for three and a half seconds to raise the orbit while you're docked, then confirm.

rail.wait: Wait — Agena's engine is firing (a few seconds).

beats.title: Fetch the experiment
beats.text: Orbit raised. Send June outside to retrieve the experiment package, then confirm; it's the reason you came up here.

rail.wait: Wait — June is outside fetching the package (time runs faster).

beats.title: Undock
beats.text: Package aboard and June's back inside. Have Cal undock from Agena; it's time to go home.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is undocking from Agena.

beats.title: Arm the RCS
beats.text: Away from Agena you steer with the RCS. Ring A's harness is damaged, so have Cal arm ring B, then confirm.

alternatives.text: Away from Agena you steer with the RCS. Ring B's harness is damaged, so have Cal arm ring A, then confirm.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is arming the ring (a few seconds).

beats.title: Hold her steady
beats.text: Ring armed. Have Cal rate damp on the RCS so the capsule holds still for the burn home.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is steadying the capsule.

beats.title: Drop the equipment section
beats.text: The equipment section has done its job. Have Cal jettison it, then confirm; only the retro pack and the capsule come home.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is jettisoning the equipment section.

beats.title: Choose the retro engine
beats.text: Now the burn home. Open the Orbit tab and the burn planner, then choose Retro sequence as the engine.

rail.do: Open the Burn planner, then choose Retro sequence.

beats.title: Pick the landing zone
beats.text: Set the goal to Zone: Primary Atlantic. That's where the recovery ships are waiting.

rail.do: Choose Zone: Primary Atlantic in the goal list.

beats.title: Propose the burn
beats.text: Press Propose and the flight computer works out when and how to fire the retros.

beats.title: Execute the burn
beats.text: Check that the ghost track ends in the zone, then press Execute.

beats.title: Confirm the retrofire
beats.text: Confirm the order. The computer holds it and fires the retros at exactly the right moment.

rail.do: Click Confirm in the dialog (closed it? Click Execute again).

beats.title: Wait for the retrofire
beats.text: The burn is booked. Time speeds up until it's due, then slows down so you can watch Cal fire the retros.

rail.do: Wait — time runs fast until the retros fire.
rail.wait: Wait — the retros are still burning.

beats.title: Drop the retro pack
beats.text: Retros done. Have Cal jettison the spent retro pack, then confirm; the capsule meets the air on its own.
beats.trigger: (@tandem/retro/rocket_4.fired and not @tandem/retro/rocket_1.burning and not @tandem/retro/rocket_2.burning and not @tandem/retro/rocket_3.burning and not @tandem/retro/rocket_4.burning and not @crew.task.active) or @mission.event.retro_sep.fired

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is jettisoning the retro pack.

beats.title: Run the entry checklist
beats.text: Last job before the air gets thick. Have Cal run the entry checklist so the parachutes come out on time.

rail.wait: Wait — Cal is running the entry checklist.

beats.title: Ride it down
beats.text: All set: expect heat, noise and a few g. The checklist deploys the drogue, then the main chute, so sit tight.

rail.do: Wait — sit tight until splashdown (time runs fast).

beats.title: Splashdown
beats.text: You're down and afloat. The recovery forces are on their way, and time runs fast until they arrive.

rail.do: Wait — the recovery ships are on their way (time runs fast).

beats.title: Go to the debrief
beats.text: Crew recovered, mission complete. Press Proceed to debrief to see how it went.

beats.title: Unknown values
beats.text: Grey numbers are unknown: press Ask, then send the request so the crew reads them.

beats.title: Source and age
beats.text: Each reading shows who took it and when, and old readings turn stale.

beats.title: Give your first order
beats.text: Pick a quick command or type an order to dock with Agena, and the crew starts the task.

beats.title: Resources and forecast
beats.text: The resource strip shows what is left and which supply runs out first.

beats.title: Power and temperature
beats.text: Each load shows its watts and what it depends on, and shedding the experiment package heater buys margin.

beats.title: Orbit map
beats.text: Prograde, retrograde and nodes live here, and the ghost track previews a burn before you commit.

alternatives.text: Prograde, retrograde and nodes live here: pick a goal and the computer will propose a burn.

beats.title: Acknowledge the alarm
beats.text: Press ACK to silence the alarm, then read what went wrong.

beats.title: Choose the engine
beats.text: Open the Orbit tab and the burn planner, then choose the engine for the retrofire.

beats.title: Ask for a proposal
beats.text: Press Propose and the flight computer plans the retrofire for you.

beats.title: Execute the burn
beats.text: Check the preview, then press Execute to order the retrofire.

beats.title: Go to the debrief
beats.text: Press Proceed to see how the mission went.
